Shim retries only when errors.As finds *pq.Error, but migrate's Lock wraps statement errors in database.Error (wrapping shown msg 39), which lacks Unwrap in every migrate version; that absence was never shown.

msgs 21/49/53 showed scheme {"cockroachdb", ..., []string{"cr","cockroach","crdb","cdb"}, "postgres"} and doc row 'CockroachDB (cockroachdb) | cr, cockroach, crdb, cdb': cockroachdb is the scheme/driver, not an alias.

ReportConf follows the *Conf names at msg 29 (SlackConf, GostConf) plus r.Config.Report (msg 21). Base Diff sits in Config; ReportConf exists only from 2cdeef4 (2021) as an interface, with Diff then in ReportOpts.
